title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_CONNECTION_ID Runtime Lifecycle Topoff Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution, state-machine inspection through public internal seams, protected packet inspection for existing retirement emission helpers, SpecTrace validation, and coverage-triage regeneration.
scope: This verification covers S19P15 runtime lifecycle behavior for local zero-length-mode send suppression, peer zero-length-mode receive rejection, duplicate and conflict handling, sequence-number-based active destination selection, monotonic Retire Prior To state, and one-time retirement reporting for stale below-threshold sequence numbers.
expected_result: Focused tests provide positive, negative, and edge proof for the selected S19P15 requirements. The peer connection-ID state keeps stale below-threshold NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames out of the active set, reports the sequence for retirement once, and does not close the connection for that RFC-required stale sequence case.
procedure: Run the focused S19P15 runtime lifecycle requirement-home filter.
Confirm local zero-length connection-ID mode suppresses NEW_CONNECTION_ID route, token, and send effects.
Confirm peer zero-length destination mode rejects received NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION without mutating existing peer destination state.
Confirm exact duplicates are accepted, non-identical sequence or connection-ID reuse is rejected, and out-of-order lower sequences do not replace the highest active destination.
Confirm smaller later Retire Prior To values do not lower the largest received threshold.
Confirm a newly received sequence below that threshold is reported once for retirement and repeated stale frames are not reported again.
Regenerate coverage triage and validate canonical SpecTrace JSON.
preconditions: Frame-codec field parsing and Retire Prior To greater-than-sequence rejection remain owned by ARC/WI/VER-QUIC-RFC9000-0013.
Protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID packet emission remains owned by the existing peer connection-ID lifecycle runtime path.
The local active_connection_id_limit defaults to the RFC minimum unless a test explicitly supplies a higher limit.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification intentionally does not close S19P15 requirements 0002 through 0013, broad migration unlinkability, preferred-address transition behavior, or any new send-boundary behavior for protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID packets.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-03. SpecTrace core validation passed 334 artifacts, the focused S19P15 runtime lifecycle filter passed 20/20, and the full solution test suite passed 3690/3690 after one isolated S10P2 timeout passed on rerun.
